items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: George Simon said he thought that the band sounded like a thundering herd.

ctx.x: And, of course, that began and was used as a way of describing our music. George Simon said he thought that the band sounded like a thundering herd. And so we just kept that as billing. And the reception to the second band was certainly not as spontaneous as the first one was. And there were some very uphill battles. People said they couldn't dance to it where it was necessary, and --
